bio.text: Angus McKelvey has represented District 6 in the Hawaii State Senate since 2022.
McKelvey previously served in the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 10, from 2006 to 2022.
McKelvey was born in Honolulu, graduated from Hawaii Preparatory Academy, and earned a B.A. in political science from Whittier College and a J.D. from Concord School of Law.
